name: premisave-messenger-service
description: Premisave messenger: chats, groups, statuses, calls.

SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE.description: dev, staging or prod. Use staging on the staging app and prod on the production app.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string (Heroku has no MongoDB of its own). Use a different database for staging and production.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis address with its password, for example rediss://default:password@host:6379 (Upstash or Redis Cloud). The Heroku Key-Value Store add-on uses a self-signed certificate and may be refused.

JWT_SECRET.description: Must equal the auth-service JWT_SECRET of the same environment.

AUTH_SERVICE_URL.description: Public address of the auth-service of the same environment, for example https://premisave-auth-staging.herokuapp.com

STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public address of this app, for example https://premisave-messenger-staging.herokuapp.com. Download links inside messages start with it.

LIVEKIT_URL.description: wss:// address of LiveKit for calls (LiveKit Cloud works). Leave empty to keep calls off.

LIVEKIT_API_URL.description: https:// address of the same LiveKit server.

LIVEKIT_API_KEY.description: LiveKit API key. Empty keeps calls off.

LIVEKIT_API_SECRET.description: LiveKit API secret, at least 32 characters.
